record: The frozen production schema the forward-migration checks are run against. Captured read-only on 2026-10-01 by scripts/backup-database.mjs (the accepted Phase 2A artifact). It is a logical dump and DOES contain real rows, so it lives only in gitignored backups/; the verification tool loads its schema and skips every data statement. Production is never a migrate target: it is checked against, never written.
dataNote: Measured with the project splitter: 788 statements total, 268 of them data (264 public rows plus 2 auth.users and 2 auth.identities). Contains personal data and password hashes — never commit, never publish. The tool re-measures this count and refuses the record if it does not match.

ledgerOnServer.note: The server's own supabase_migrations bookkeeping at capture time. It does not match the repository directory (169 files, newest 0177); that divergence is exactly why this baseline exists and why history is never replayed.

policy.note: No migration file from supabase/migrations may be replayed onto production as history. Measured 2026-10-01: 30 of 169 files fail when replayed onto this schema. Production moves only by individually verified NEW files (0178+), at the release gate, through the sanctioned path.

measuredMismatchExamples: 0177 fails on this schema: neither public.get_my_shop_request(text) nor public.process_reminders() exists here.
The repository lineage and production diverge in both directions (e.g. this schema has no payments table; it has customer_payments).
